cases.name: language / buffers: a function that pads each line of a buffer
cases.source:
Buffer rightAlign(Buffer listing) {
    Regexp upToBreak = regexp ".*"
    Buffer result = create
    int pos = 0
    int widest = 0
    while (pos < length listing) {
        if (!search(upToBreak, listing, pos)) break
        string entry = listing[pos:pos + end(0)]
        if (length entry > widest) widest = length entry
        pos += end(0) + 2
    }
    pos = 0
    while (pos < length listing) {
        if (!search(upToBreak, listing, pos)) break
        string entry = listing[pos:pos + end(0)]
        pos += end(0) + 2
        int i
        for (i = length entry; i < widest; i++) result += '.'
        result += entry
        result += "|\n"
    }
    int col
    for (col = 0; col < widest; col++) result += '='
    result += '\n'
    return result
}
Buffer parts = create
parts = "bolt\nwasher\nnut"
Stream sink = write "aligned.txt"
sink << rightAlign(parts)
close sink
print readFile "aligned.txt"
